result.title: Accounting Policy Manual - posting authority, support, approvals
result.text:
HALVARD SYSTEMS - ACCOUNTING POLICY MANUAL (excerpt), effective 2026-01-01
Applies to Halvard Systems Inc. (US), Halvard Systems Ltd (UK), Halvard Systems GmbH (DE).

1. Posting authority. Senior accountants may post manual journal entries up to USD 10,000
   per entry (local-currency entries are measured at the month-end rate of the entry month).
   Any entry above USD 10,000 must be routed to the Controller with an approval request
   (request_approval) immediately after posting; it remains pending until approved.
   Splitting one transaction into several entries to stay under the threshold is prohibited.
2. Support. Every journal entry must have its supporting document(s) attached. An entry
   without support is not a valid entry.
3. Capitalization. Individual equipment purchases of USD 2,500 or more (local-currency
   equivalent at the month-end rate) are capitalized to 1500 Computer Equipment and
   depreciated over 36 months beginning the month after acquisition.
4. Prepaids. Payments covering services or events in future periods (more than one month
   out, or spanning more than one month) above USD 1,000 are recorded as prepaid (1210
   Prepaid Software for software, 1220 Prepaid Insurance for insurance, 1200 Prepaid Expenses
   for everything else, including deposits for future events) and expensed straight-line over
   the coverage period starting the month coverage begins, or when the event occurs.
5. Accruals. Expenses are recorded in the period the goods or services are received. Services
   received but not yet invoiced at month-end are accrued to 2100 Accrued Expenses using the
   best available evidence (vendor statements, approved timesheets, engagement terms).
   Quotes or proposals for future work are not liabilities.
6. Revenue. Revenue is recognized under ASC 606 per the contract terms. Deferred revenue
   (2200) is released as performance obligations are satisfied. Usage earned but not yet
   invoiced is recorded to 1300 Unbilled Receivables.
7. Customer credits. SLA credits are issued only per contract terms and verified uptime data
   (see the monthly uptime report). Credits are recorded as a reduction of the related revenue.
8. Cash application. Customer receipts are applied to invoices per remittance advice. Receipts
   that cannot be matched to an open invoice remain in 2950 Unapplied Cash.
9. FX. Monetary balances denominated in a currency other than the entity's functional
   currency are remeasured at the month-end rate; gains/losses go to 6950 FX Gain/Loss.
   Intercompany charges are recorded by the receiving entity at the month-end rate of the
   month charged.
10. Payroll. Returned payroll deposits are recorded to 2150 Accrued Payroll & Unclaimed
   Wages until reissued. Unpaid wages at month-end are accrued to 2150.
11. Exceptions. Items that cannot be supported must be reported via flag_exception. Never
   post an entry to force a reconciliation or to make balances agree.
12. Periods. January and February 2026 are closed. March 2026 is open.

No engagement letter, invoice, or wire instruction was found in the document store (searched: legal, retainer, counsel, wire, 7731). Need: vendor identity, engagement/retainer terms and invoice. If the retainer covers future services (>1 month, >USD 1,000) it should be reclassed to 1200 Prepaid Expenses per policy sec. 4 and amortized. Left in 6500 pending support.

Possible vendor-side double charge: two identical Zoom card charges of USD 149.90 on 2026-03-08 (JE-00248/DOC-0175 and JE-00249/DOC-0174), both cleared the bank (BT-US-0062, BT-US-0063). Ledger agrees with bank and each charge has a receipt, so no ledger correction was made. March has 5 Zoom charges (USD 749.50) vs 3 in Jan and 2 in Feb. Recommend card admin confirm with Zoom whether 03-08 was billed twice and pursue a refund/chargeback; record any credit when received.

args.text:
MEMO – US March 2026 AP & Expense Review
Prepared by: Senior Accountant (david.murguia@gmail.com) | Date: 2026-04-03 | Entity: Halvard Systems Inc. (USD)

SCOPE
Reviewed all 42 US ledger entries for period 2026-03 (AP, card, manual, payroll, AR), all 14 postings to 2000 Accounts Payable, all 7 US March vendor bills in the document store, the March operating bank statement (DOC-0204), and Jan/Feb comparatives. Tested for duplicates, miscoding, missing support, wrong entity, prepaid/capitalization treatment, and cutoff.

CORRECTIONS POSTED
1. Duplicate AP posting – Stackline Cloud STA-98877, USD 31,148.20
   Invoice DOC-0160 (service period March 2026) was posted twice by ap.clerk: JE-00232 (03-03) and JE-00241 (03-05). Only one payment cleared (JE-00281 / bank BT-US-0077, 03-22). Effect: 5000 Hosting and 2000 AP overstated by 31,148.20.
   Action: JE-00307 (dated 2026-03-31) reverses JE-00241; support DOC-0160 attached.
   APPROVAL REQUIRED: entry exceeds USD 10,000 posting authority – request_approval submitted, status pending_approval. Please approve.

2. Miscoding – Northgate Data Centers NDC-7719, USD 3,880.00
   JE-00250 memo read "team dinner" and was coded to 6310 Meals & Entertainment. Invoice DOC-0172 is colocation (2 racks, power, cross-connects, March 2026).
   Action: JE-00308 (2026-03-31) Dr 5000 Hosting & Infrastructure / Cr 6310 Meals & Entertainment 3,880.00; support DOC-0172 attached. Under threshold; no approval needed. After reclass, 6310 March activity is 49.75 (Sweetgreen team lunch only). NDC-7719 remains correctly open in AP (unpaid at 03-31).

EXCEPTIONS FLAGGED (not corrected – cannot be supported)
3. EXC-001 – JE-00288 "Legal retainer" USD 6,750.00 (Dr 6500 / Cr 1000), manual entry by j.doe on 03-24, NO supporting document. Bank confirms a 6,750.00 wire out on 03-24 to "ACCT ENDING 7731" (BT-US-0080), so cash did leave and the entry was not reversed. No engagement letter, invoice, or wire instruction exists in the document store. Need vendor identity and retainer terms. If it covers future services (>1 month and >USD 1,000) it belongs in 1200 Prepaid Expenses per policy sec. 4, not 6500.

4. EXC-002 – Possible Zoom vendor double-charge. Two identical USD 149.90 card charges on 03-08 (JE-00248/DOC-0175 and JE-00249/DOC-0174), both cleared the bank (BT-US-0062/0063). Ledger agrees with bank and each has a receipt, so no ledger change. March has 5 Zoom charges (749.50) vs 3 in Jan and 2 in Feb. Recommend card admin confirm with Zoom and pursue a refund; book any credit on receipt.

ITEMS REVIEWED – NO ISSUE
- Lumen rent 14,500 (6100), Quire Docs 640 (6200), Tessellate BI 1,950 (6200), Con Edison 922.22 (6110), Oakridge Creative 7,686 (6400): each posted once, matches invoice, service period March 2026, coded correctly, paid per bank.
- All 7 US March vendor bills in the document store are in the ledger; no unrecorded March bills found (cutoff OK). No UK/DE vendor bills posted to US.
- Card charges (Amazon, Staples, Sweetgreen, Hilton, Delta, Uber x2): all under capitalization/prepaid thresholds, receipts attached, coded appropriately.
- No March items meet the USD 2,500 capitalization or USD 1,000 multi-period prepaid criteria other than possibly the unsupported legal retainer (see EXC-001).
- Payroll (JE-00265, JE-00302) and funding transfers agree to bank.

RESULTING BALANCES (US, 2026-03)
- 2000 AP: March activity –3,880.00 (open NDC-7719 only); ending –100,180.00. The 96,300 carry-in is the audited FY2025 opening balance from migration JE-00013 (Jan/Feb bills were all paid within period) – not a March issue, but it appears to be aging and should be looked at separately.
- 5000 Hosting: March activity 35,028.20 (Stackline 31,148.20 + Northgate 3,880.00).
- 6310 M&E: March activity 49.75.
- 6500 Legal: 6,750.00 (unsupported, EXC-001).

CHECKLIST
- US "AP cutoff review" marked complete (with exceptions above).
- Bank reconciliation not performed (separate checklist item); bank lines were used as evidence only and remain unmatched.

OPEN FOR CONTROLLER
(a) Approve JE-00307. (b) Resolve EXC-001 (obtain legal retainer support; possible reclass to prepaid). (c) EXC-002 Zoom refund follow-up. (d) Consider review of the 96,300 legacy AP balance.
